'''1997 Decipher World Championship Joe Alread DS''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Joe Alread]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/DarkJoe.html Joe Alread's 1997 WF Dark Deck], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991104014459/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/DarkJoe.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Introduction ==
[[Joe Alread]] played this deck at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]. It holds the [[Imperial Holotable]] and inserts [[3,720 To 1]] from Star Destroyers in [[Asteroid Field]]s.<ref name="torch" />
